question: What is the total number of orders placed in the system?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_orders FROM fct_orders;

question: What is the total revenue in BRL across all orders?
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(grand_total_brl), 2) AS total_revenue FROM fct_orders;

question: What is the average customer review score across all orders?
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(customer_review_score), 2) AS avg_csat FROM fct_orders WHERE customer_review_score IS NOT NULL;

question: How many distinct customers have made purchases?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT customer_unique_id) AS unique_customers FROM dim_customers;

question: How many repeat buyers vs single buyers exist?
gold_sql: SELECT buyer_type, COUNT(*) AS buyer_count FROM dim_customers GROUP BY buyer_type ORDER BY buyer_count DESC;

question: What is the total revenue by customer LTV segment?
gold_sql: SELECT ltv_segment, ROUND(SUM(total_lifetime_spend_brl), 2) AS segment_revenue FROM customer_ltv GROUP BY ltv_segment ORDER BY segment_revenue DESC;

question: How many customers are categorized in each LTV segment?
gold_sql: SELECT ltv_segment, COUNT(*) AS customer_count FROM customer_ltv GROUP BY ltv_segment ORDER BY customer_count DESC;

question: What is the average order ticket size by LTV segment?
gold_sql: SELECT ltv_segment, ROUND(AVG(avg_order_ticket_brl), 2) AS avg_ticket FROM customer_ltv GROUP BY ltv_segment ORDER BY avg_ticket DESC;

question: How many delayed orders occurred across all states?
gold_sql: SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN is_delayed_delivery THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS delayed_count FROM fct_orders;

question: What are the top 5 states by total order volume?
gold_sql: SELECT customer_state, COUNT(*) AS order_vol FROM fct_orders WHERE customer_state IS NOT NULL GROUP BY customer_state ORDER BY order_vol DESC LIMIT 5;

question: What are the top 5 states by regional GMV?
gold_sql: SELECT state_code, ROUND(SUM(regional_gmv_brl), 2) AS gmv FROM mart_geo_performance GROUP BY state_code ORDER BY gmv DESC LIMIT 5;

question: Which 3 states have the highest delivery delay percentage?
gold_sql: SELECT state_code, ROUND(AVG(delay_rate_percentage), 2) AS avg_delay_pct FROM mart_geo_performance GROUP BY state_code ORDER BY avg_delay_pct DESC LIMIT 3;

question: What is the total number of products in the catalog?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_products FROM dim_products;

question: How many products exist in each weight class?
gold_sql: SELECT weight_class, COUNT(*) AS product_count FROM dim_products GROUP BY weight_class ORDER BY product_count DESC;

question: What are the top 5 product categories by product count?
gold_sql: SELECT product_category, COUNT(*) AS item_count FROM dim_products GROUP BY product_category ORDER BY item_count DESC LIMIT 5;

question: How many sellers are categorized in each seller tier?
gold_sql: SELECT seller_tier, COUNT(*) AS seller_count FROM dim_sellers GROUP BY seller_tier ORDER BY seller_count DESC;

question: What is the total merchandise revenue generated by all sellers?
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(total_revenue_brl), 2) AS total_seller_rev FROM dim_sellers;

question: What is the average item sale price across all sellers?
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(average_ticket_brl), 2) AS avg_ticket FROM dim_sellers;

question: How many payment transactions were made via credit card?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS cc_count FROM fct_order_payments WHERE is_credit_card_payment = TRUE;

question: What is the total payment value settled by payment type?
gold_sql: SELECT payment_type, ROUND(SUM(payment_amount), 2) AS total_paid FROM fct_order_payments GROUP BY payment_type ORDER BY total_paid DESC;

question: How many orders used split installment financing?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS split_count FROM fct_order_payments WHERE is_split_installment = TRUE;

question: What is the average freight amount per order?
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(freight_total_brl), 2) AS avg_freight FROM fct_orders;

question: What is the total freight billed across all orders?
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(freight_total_brl), 2) AS total_freight FROM fct_orders;

question: What is the distribution of orders by order status?
gold_sql: SELECT order_status, COUNT(*) AS count_by_status FROM fct_orders GROUP BY order_status ORDER BY count_by_status DESC;

question: How many orders received a 5-star review rating?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS five_star_count FROM fct_orders WHERE customer_review_score = 5.0;

question: How many orders received a 1-star review rating?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS one_star_count FROM fct_orders WHERE customer_review_score = 1.0;

question: What is the average CSAT satisfaction score in the customer LTV mart?
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(satisfaction_score), 2) AS avg_csat FROM customer_ltv;

question: What is the total number of sellers in the marketplace?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_sellers FROM dim_sellers;

question: What is the maximum lifetime spend recorded by any customer?
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(MAX(total_lifetime_spend_brl), 2) AS max_spend FROM customer_ltv;

question: How many products belong to the lightweight class?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS lightweight_count FROM dim_products WHERE weight_class = 'lightweight';

question: How many products belong to the heavyweight class?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS heavyweight_count FROM dim_products WHERE weight_class = 'heavyweight';

question: What is the average product weight in grams across all products?
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(product_weight_grams), 2) AS avg_weight FROM dim_products WHERE product_weight_grams IS NOT NULL;

question: What is the total freight revenue by state in geo performance?
gold_sql: SELECT state_code, ROUND(SUM(avg_freight_cost_brl * total_orders), 2) AS state_freight FROM mart_geo_performance GROUP BY state_code ORDER BY state_freight DESC LIMIT 5;

question: How many total items were sold by all sellers combined?
gold_sql: SELECT SUM(total_items_sold) AS total_items FROM dim_sellers;

question: What is the total count of tier 1 top sellers?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS top_sellers_count FROM dim_sellers WHERE seller_tier = 'tier_1_top_seller';

question: What is the average number of catalog photos per product?
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(catalog_photo_count), 2) AS avg_photos FROM dim_products WHERE catalog_photo_count IS NOT NULL;

question: How many distinct cities are recorded in dim_customers?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT primary_city) AS distinct_cities FROM dim_customers;

question: How many distinct states are represented in dim_customers?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT primary_state) AS distinct_states FROM dim_customers;

question: What is the total merchandise total in BRL across all orders?
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(merchandise_total_brl), 2) AS merchandise_gmv FROM fct_orders;

question: What is the total number of order items fulfilled?
gold_sql: SELECT SUM(total_order_items) AS total_items_fulfilled FROM fct_orders;

question: What is the average volume in cubic cm for all products?
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(product_volume_cm3), 2) AS avg_volume FROM dim_products WHERE product_volume_cm3 IS NOT NULL;

question: How many orders have a delivered order status?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS delivered_count FROM fct_orders WHERE order_status = 'delivered';

question: What is the maximum freight charge billed on any single order?
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(MAX(freight_total_brl), 2) AS max_freight FROM fct_orders;

question: What is the minimum item ticket recorded in dim_sellers?
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(MIN(average_ticket_brl), 2) AS min_ticket FROM dim_sellers WHERE average_ticket_brl > 0;

question: What is the count of High Value VIP customers in the LTV mart?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS vip_count FROM customer_ltv WHERE ltv_segment = 'High Value VIP';
